d: The Jensen Huang scandal is now colliding with Nvidia’s business. The US has introduced new licensing requirements for advanced American chips sold to data centres in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil. Washington says the rules are designed to stop restricted countries, particularly China, from gaining access to advanced computing power through overseas data centres and remote cloud services. At the same time, pressure is building inside and outside Nvidia to bring Jensen Huang back. More than 180,000 people have reportedly signed a petition supporting his return,…
